product.name: Clearwater Shallow Dig Cesspool
product.description:
Clearwater shallow dig cesspools are a great option for off-mains buildings where the surrounding area means it’s not possible to install a soakaway to go hand in hand with a septic tank or sewage treatment plant. Clearwater cesspools are for use in situations where there is a high winter water table, where the area of installation is a protected zone or if the soil it will be installed in to is the wrong type to allow a drainage field to be installed.
These shallow dig cesspools have 1 inlet and a lid, which can be removed for the contents to be pumped out by a specialist operator. As a total containment tank, these shallow dig cesspools from Clearwater can be used for the storage of surface water, animal waste, as rainwater harvesting reservoirs and as firefighting reservoirs in areas where there are no mains connections. This cesspool cannot be used for the storage of drinking water.
By opting for this Clearwater shallow dig cesspool labour costs and installation time is minimised as less ground needs to be excavated. Manufactured from chemically resistant and watertight GRP, on dry sites these cesspools can be backfilled with pea shingles with no concerns over durability or stability on the cesspool.
Please note: For collecting and storing the effluence of a domestic, commercial or industrial building, the smallest capacity cesspool that must be used, to comply with building regulations, is 18000 litres.
product.variant_name: Clearwater Shallow Dig Cesspool - 2800 litres

product.name: Clearwater Shallow Dig Septic Tank
product.description:
Clearwater shallow dig septic tanks are the perfect choice for when sewage treatment plants, which discharge cleaned effluent into the ground, are not suitable. Throughout the Clearwater septic tank range, this is the highest capacity tank and it can store the effluent of up to 47 people, perfect for off-mains domestic properties, holiday homes and static caravans.
To reduce costs and installation time this septic tank is shallow dig, meaning you need to excavate less of the ground where it will be installed. Save on labour costs even more on dry sites too as this septic tank can be backfilled with pea shingles. There’s no need to worry about the durability of this septic tank with pea shingles or concrete backfill as it’s manufactured from strong, chemically resistant and watertight GRP.
99.7% efficient and approved to EN12566-1, these septic tanks are the perfect upgrade from traditional cesspools as they tend to last longer, increase hygiene and have improved efficiency in the treatment of waste.

product.name: Fernco Rubber Flexible Drainage Adaptor Coupling
product.description: Designed to meet and surpass the rigorous requirements of the drainage marketplace, this adaptor coupling from Fernco (formerly Flexseal) delivers a solution for numerous adaptation situations. It can be used to connect pipelines that are different materials such as metal, cast iron and vitrified clay pipes.Including a step-moulded elastomeric sleeve with differing diameters at each end, this adaptor coupling is fitted with two stainless steel clamping bands that offer an effective method for joining pipes that have various outer diameters. This ensures it is cost-effective, eliminating potential bush requirements. product.description: Designed to meet and surpass the rigorous requirements of the drainage marketplace, this adaptor coupling from Fernco (formerly Flexseal) delivers a solution for numerous adaptation situations. It can be used to connect pipelines that are different materials such as metal, cast iron and vitrified clay pipes.Including a step-moulded elastomeric sleeve with differing diameters at each end, this adaptor coupling is fitted with two stainless steel clamping bands that offer an effective method for joining pipes that have various outer diameters. This ensures it is cost-effective, eliminating potential bush requirements. It is also suitable for connecting all new and traditional pipe systems including structural walled plastic pipes.Features & Benefits: Fernco Rubber Flexible Drainage Adaptor CouplingRange of diameters availableHigh-performance sealing qualitiesEradicates the need for grouting in most applicationsShear band ensures pipe alignment and joint flexibilityComplies with WIS 4-41-01 for all public sewers and sewers for adoptionReduces excavation workStainless steel shear band for excellent resistance to shear forces and heavy loadsDurable design with a reliable seal50-year manufacturer’s guaranteeSpecial ranges of adaptor couplings integrate an extra wide clamping band at one end and are also available for ribbed pipe systems. The clamping band fastens against two or more external ribs on the plastic ribbed pipe to ensure a high-performance seal regardless of the coupling movement or position.

product.name: Fernco Puddle Flange for Drain Pipes
product.description: Formerly Flexseal, Fernco Puddle Flanges serve the purpose of sealing the area around pipes that pass through concrete structures like tanks, manhole chambers, shafts, floor slabs and basements. Manufactured from sturdy EPDM, these reliable flanges are typically installed during the construction phase.When pipes pass through concrete, they do not bond to the concrete, creating a potential route for water to flow along the external surface of the pipe. However, Fernco Puddle Flanges act as a barrier, preventing water penetration in such situations. The flange is clamped onto the pipe, obstructing this direct water route. During the pouring process, the seal body is compressed, and if the concrete shrinks during curing, the rubber in the flange relaxes and maintains a seal, preventing any water flow along this path.Features & Benefits: Fernco Puddle Flange for Drain PipesHighly versatile, cost-effective solution for sealing pipes which pass through concreteSuitable for use in walls, floors and ceilingsGood chemical resistanceQuick & easy to installAvailable in a wide range of sizes

product.description: Formerly Flexseal, Fernco Puddle Flanges serve the purpose of sealing the area around pipes that pass through concrete structures like tanks, manhole chambers, shafts, floor slabs and basements. Manufactured from sturdy EPDM, these reliable flanges are typically installed during the construction phase.When pipes pass through concrete, they do not bond to the concrete, creating a potential route for water to flow along the external surface of the pipe. However, Fernco Puddle Flanges act as a barrier, preventing water penetration in such situations. The flange is clamped onto the pipe, obstructing this direct water route. During the pouring process, the seal body is compressed, and if the concrete shrinks during curing, the rubber in the flange relaxes and maintains a seal, preventing any water flow along this path.Features & Benefits: Fernco Puddle Flange for Drain PipesHighly versatile, cost-effective solution for sealing pipes which pass through concreteSuitable for use in walls, floors and ceilingsGood chemical resistanceQuick & easy to installAvailable in a wide range of sizes

product.name: Caroflow LoLine Vinyl Floor Shower Outlet

product.name: Caroflow Roof Drain Threaded Adaptor
product.description: From Caroflow, this roof drain threaded adaptor is used to extend the length of outlets. With a male taper at one end compliant with BS21, this adaptor is perfect for joining into any Caroflow threaded connection outlets. From vertical threaded to two-way outlets and more. The other end is chamfered to BSEN 1566:2004 spigot dimensions and comes in a variety of sizes to ensure you find the right size for your outlet. As an extending section, this adaptor can be used whenever extra length is required. You can opt for different lengths to find the right one for your extension requirements. Whether it's a joint between the outlet and pipework that's likely to be cast within a concrete slab or a two-way outlet is going to connect directly to 'O' ring socketed PVC pipework, these adaptors can be the solution you need.Features & Benefits: Caroflow Roof Drain Threaded AdaptorUsed for extending the length of outletsSuitable for most roof finishes including Caroflow spigot roof outletsVariety of lengths and pipe diameters to choose fromMale threaded taper end to BS21Manufactured using ABS plastic

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style 110mm Plastic 92.5 Degree Double Socket Boss Branch
product.description: Designed with long-lasting rubber seals, retained by strong snap caps, this double socket boss branch is quick and easy to install with a convenient Push-fit installation for prolonged reliability and minimal maintenance. Perfect for connecting multiple soil pipes in a soil system, this branch is available in a range of heritage colours to match your soil and rainwater systems.Providing the authentic detailing and finish of traditional cast-iron soil systems of heritage designed buildings, this branch is a lightweight, affordable alternative to cast iron, making it cost-effective and easy to handle. product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Corner Round Plastic Downpipe
product.description:
This Roundstyle uPVC plastic downpipe aims to create a steady path that effortlessly directs rainwater towards the pipe shoe and to the drain. Including lugs for easy and quick attachments, this plastic downpipe fits neatly into a 68mm downpipe system that settles into a corner. 
Like its fellow Cascade products, this Roundstyle downpipe features a cast iron adjacent finish that creates a rustic and traditional feel. While this downpipe is suited to newer applications, it is also ideal for modern refurbishments on heritage buildings where cast iron products may need replacing. In this Cascade downpipe, Brett Martin provides a versatile product that successfully fulfills its purpose and that can increase efficiency in authentic cast iron systems. Features & Benefits: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Corner Round Plastic DownpipeA range of sizes accessible  Quality plastic that deters damage and breakage  UV stabilised to prevent sun bleaching  Roundstyle profile  Corrosion resilient  Lightweight for easy handling and installing.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Corner Round Plastic Small Ogee Hopper
product.description:
The Cascade corner downpipe system is synonymous with traditional cast iron styling and blends perfectly with the architectural detailing on heritage buildings, being virtually indistinguishable from original cast iron systems. This system is used on the corners of properties.
The authentic styling of the round downpipe system is suitable for both period styled new build and renovation projects alike.
Pipe couplers allow for more than one downpipe to be connected in series. Cast iron connectors are sometimes decoratively branded. Plastic downpipes may, however, just join by sitting the upper pipe inside the lower, without connectors, which creates a watertight seal.
Funnel-shaped rainwater collector that diverts to a downpipe.
Features

Authentic detailing and finish on guttering, downpipe, hoppers and fittings
Fully compatible with the Cast Iron Style Soil System and traditional Cast Iron

Incorporates 65mm Square Downpipe and 68mm Round Downpipe

product.description:
The Cascade Cast Iron Style Rainwater System is synonymous with traditional cast iron styling and blends perfectly with the architectural detailing on heritage buildings, being virtually indistinguishable from original cast ron systems.
The authentic styling of the Cascade system is suitable for both period styled new build and renovation projects alike.
Funnel-shaped rainwater collector that diverts to a downpipe.
Elaborate cast iron and lead versions are of great significance on many façades of historical buildings, on some old houses, hoppers took out grey water, but this is not permitted now.
Features

Authentic detailing and finish on guttering, downpipe, hoppers and fittings
Fully compatible with the Cast Iron Style Soil System and traditional Cast Iron
Incorporates 65mm Square Downpipe and 68mm Round Downpipe

Achieve all the benefits of plastic guttering with all the traditional and period style looks of Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering. Use this pipe coupler to connect more than one downpipe in a run to scale higher or more difficult building facades. Sitting a Cascade Cast Iron Style downpipe in the top of this pipe coupler will offer a watertight seal without the need for any other fixings.
Cascade Cast Iron Style Guttering
Achieve all the benefits of plastic guttering with all the traditional and period style looks of Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering. Manufactured from plastic, the guttering is designed to look like cast iron so it’s a match to heritage and listed properties. As the plastic cast iron style guttering isn’t as heavy as actual cast iron guttering you can be reassured that installing new guttering won’t make any damage to the property.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Downpipe
product.description:
Ideal for channelling rainwater from your roof into your drains, this uPVC downpipe is available in a range of heritage colours, lengths and diameters to choose from and fit the architectural appearance of your building. Ready to fit, this downpipe is easy to install with the Cast Iron Style Round downpipe fittings.
Perfectly suited for traditionally designed buildings, renovation projects and period styled new builds, this downpipe blends perfectly with the architectural detail of heritage buildings with authentic detailing and finish and the appearance of original Cast Iron. As an affordable, lighter alternative to traditional cast iron styling, this uPVC downpipe is durable, non-corrosive and UV resistant ensuring a reliable and secure installation with low maintenance requirements. Fully compatible with existing rainwater systems, this downpipe can be incorporated with the Roundstyle or Deepstyle Domestic Rainwater System at 68mm and with the Deepstyle High Capacity Rainwater System at 105mm.
Features & Benefits: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Downpipe Quick and easy to install and ready to fit  Available in a wide range of heritage colours, lengths and diameters to choose from  Made from durable, non-corrosive and UV resistant uPVC material  Authentic detailing and finish for your architectural needs for renovation projects, traditionally designed buildings and period styled new builds  Lightweight and affordable alternative to cast iron  Low maintenance requirements with a reliable and secure installation  Made to British Standards  Can be incorporated with the Deepstyle or Roundstyle Domestic Rainwater Systems or the Deepstyle High Capacity Rainwater System with the Cast Iron Style Round Downpipe fittings  Fully compatible with traditional Cast Iron, the Cast Iron Style Soil System and existing rainwater systemsThis downpipe is fully compatible with the Cast Iron Soil System and traditional Cast Iron. The 105mm downpipe can be part of a higher drainage efficiency of rainwater for larger roof areas ensuring a higher capacity rainwater system, making it ideal for a variety of large heritage style buildings.

Available in a wide variety of colours, diameters and angles to fit around obstructions and corners of your building, this pipe bend will help direct rainwater from your gutters into the drains below, ensuring water runs vertically, reducing debris build-up. Ideal for renovation projects, period styled new builds and traditionally designed buildings.
With authentic finish and detailing, this pipe bend is synonymous with traditional cast iron styling and blends perfectly with the architectural detailing on heritage buildings and is virtually impossible to differentiate from original Cast Iron systems. The 68mm pipe bend is efficiently compatible with the Roundstyle and Deepstyle Domestic Rainwater System while the 105mm pipe bend is compatible with the Deepstyle High Capacity Rainwater System. The Deepstyle compatibility ensures a higher capacity semi-elliptical rainwater system and provides higher drainage efficiency on larger roof areas making it perfect for a great variety of large heritage style buildings.Features & Benefits: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Pipe BendFully UV stabilised, resisting sun damage  Available in a range of colours, diameters and angles to fit your building requirements  Authentic detailing and finish for traditionally designed buildings, renovation projects and period styled new builds  Robust and non-corrodible uPVC material  Lightweight and affordable alternative to cast iron  Ready to fit for a fast, easy, safe and cost-effective installation  Minimal maintenance requirements with a secure and reliable installation  Made in accordance with British Standards  Compatible with existing rainwater systems, Cast Iron Style Soil System and traditional Cast IronFully compatible with traditional Cast Iron, the Cast Iron Style Soil System and existing rainwater systems, this uPVC pipe bend is an affordable and lighter alternative to cast iron while remaining durable and corrosion-resistant. Suited for period designed new builds, renovation projects and traditionally styled buildings, this uPVC offset is finished with authentic detailing making it synonymous with traditional cast iron styling, blending perfectly with the architectural detail on heritage buildings. These downpipe clips are part of the Roundstyle Cast Iron Style Rainwater System, synonymous with traditional cast iron styling and blends perfectly with the architectural detailing on heritage buildings, being virtually indistinguishable from original Cast Iron systems.
The authentic styling of the Roundstyle system is suitable for both period styled new build and renovation projects alike.
Secures a downpipe to the wall - there should be one positioned near the top of the first pipe and then around every metre after that.
Two sorts are generally available: the saddle bracket and the barrel clip.
The saddle bracket just holds the pipe away from the wall while the barrel clip gives a firmer grip to the pipe and prevents it moving up and down.
Cascade Cast Iron Style Guttering
Achieve all the benefits of plastic guttering with all the traditional and period style looks of Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering. Manufactured from plastic, the guttering is designed to look like cast iron so it’s a match to heritage and listed properties. As the plastic cast iron style guttering isn’t as heavy as actual cast iron guttering you can be reassured that installing new guttering won’t make any damage to the property.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Adjustable Offset
product.description:
For an offset to confidently attach your guttering from the roofline to your downpipe, this Roundstyle adjustable offset is the perfect option for creating this connection and allowing the downpipe system to fix against the wall. 
This adjustable offset exists alongside the rest of the Cascade cast iron range by Brett Martin, and appropriately connects to a 68mm downpipe on modern applications that encompass an archaic building style. The finish perfectly parallels a genuine cast iron pipe, in turn making it ideal to substitute one in applications where you want a conventional design but still wish to incorporate modern-day expertise. For that much desired adjustability, this offset can be utilised in sizes from 250mm to 650mm.Features & Benefits: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Adjustable OffsetVersatile in sizing and colour for an assortment of installations and aesthetics  Durable uPVC plastic construction that won’t corrode  Withstands excellently against UV damage  Easy to handle.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Deepstyle Plastic Fascia Bracket
product.description:
Ideal for providing support for your Deepstyle Cascade Cast Iron style gutters while securely attached to a fascia board, you can choose from a variety of colours and sizes to fit your gutter system needs. An ideal replacement for cast iron, with the benefit of being a lighter, more affordable alternative.
This quality uPVC fascia bracket is ready to fit, making it quick and easy to install while being fully compatible with the Cast Iron Style Soil System. With authentic detailing and finish, this fascia bracket is designed to fit the architectural features of a traditionally designed building and renovation project, providing a heritage style while remaining uncompromised on the architectural integrity of your building. Made from non-corrosive, UV resistant and robust material, this fascia bracket is compatible with your existing rainwater system. Ideal for high-capacity semi-elliptical rainwater systems, the Deepstyle gutters provide greater drainage efficiency for larger roof areas.Features & Benefits: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Deepstyle Plastic Fascia BracketAvailable in a range of colours and sizes  An ideal alternative to cast iron  Cost-effective and affordable  Lightweight and easy to install  Quick and ready to fit  Robust, non-corrosive uPVC material  Compatible with existing rainwater systems  Suitable for high-capacity rainwater applications  Authentic detailing and finish of cast-iron architectural features  Minimal maintenance requirements and a secure fitting  Manufactured to British Standards  Economical, fast and efficient installationYour Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering can easily be installed at a 12mm slope at 3m intervals for maximum water flow towards outlets with your fascia brackets fixing your gutters in place at a minimum of 1m intervals. The 170mm Deepstyle fascia bracket is well suited for commercial or residential projects and traditional churches, Georgian and Victorian shop frontage and larger period dwellings.

Features

Authentic detailing and finish on downpipe, guttering, hoppers and fittings.
Fully compatible with the Cast Iron Style Soil System.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Rectangular Plastic 112.5 Degree Side Spigot Offset
product.description:
This 112.5 degree bend will allow you to keep your downpipe as close to the wall as possible to ensure vertical water runs. This will reduce debris build up and keep your guttering system high capacity for longer.
Cascade Cast Iron Style Guttering
Achieve all the benefits of plastic guttering with all the traditional and period style looks of Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering. Manufactured from plastic, the guttering is designed to look like cast iron so it’s a match to heritage and listed properties. As the plastic cast iron style guttering isn’t as heavy as actual cast iron guttering you can be reassured that installing new guttering won’t make any damage to the property.
The high capacity 170mm deepstyle guttering can be installed on residential projects, commercial projects and traditional church or school buildings too. The gutters are designed to hold a high capacity of water so any roofs with a large surface area can benefit from Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering. Choose between ogee, bath, motiffed and gothic hoppers to complement your cast iron style guttering and to achieve the period detailing so common in cast iron materials. The authentic-looking hoppers will give an attractive finishing touch whilst remaining affordable and resistant to corrosion.
Install Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering with a 12mm slope at 3m intervals for maximum water flow towards outlets and fix the gutters in place at a minimum of 1m intervals.
product.variant_name: Cascade Cast Iron Style Black 100 x 75mm 112.5 Dg Side Spigot Offset

product.name: Marsh Portapurra Temporary Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The portable and compact Portapura sewage treatment tank from Marsh Industries has been specifically designed for temporary accommodation (caravans/travel homes), site offices, site toilets and workshops. The Portapura can be installed above or below ground and treats domestic wastewater to a level that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard.
What are the benefits of choosing Marsh Portapura?
This compact and portable sewage treatment tank is designed specifically for temporary buildings. Design objectives included performance, running costs, installation, transport and storage, making the Portapura the logical choice for sites where temporary buildings are required.
The Portapura’s compact design provides quick and easy installation (where below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours) with minimum visual impact on the surrounding landscape as well as simple and safe access for maintenance and cleaning.  Systems can be installed above ground and removed/stored when not in use.
The cost of installing and running the Portapura is minimal when compared to larger, commercial systems making it one of the more cost-effective sewage treatment tanks on the market.
Another benefit of choosing the Portapura sewage treatment tank is its impact on the environment. Being CE?approved to BS EN 12566 with an ammonia result that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard means the Portapura is well within discharge consent requirements.
Technical

Available in three sizes - 2, 3 or 5 person units (gravity or pumped outlet)
Compact, lightweight construction - No heavy plant required
Portable
Cost effective installation - Below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours
Outstanding treatment efficiency - 14:19:0.7mg/ltr (BOD:Suspended solids:Ammonia)
Near silent air compressor - Ensures minimal running, maintenance and servicing costs
Electrical consumption: 1.8kWh/d - Equivalent to the daily use of a lightbulb
CE?approved to BS?EN 12566
Fire resistance tested in accordance with EN ISO 11925-2:210
Tested for structural integrity in accordance with EN ISO 179-1/1eA
Neck extensions are available for deeper installations

Do not install a Portapura treatment plant in water logged or uneven ground.
Do not remove the covers of the Portapura, or access the unit in any way, without firstly isolating the mains power.

product.name: Lindab Half Round Copper Gutter External Corner
product.description:
A limited range of Rainline products are available in uncoated copper. The finish is highly desirable and provides excellent corrosion resistance once it has transitioned to a greenish verdigris patina.
Rainline is ideal for modern and traditional buildings for both refurbishments and new build projects. Gutters and downpipes simply push together without the need for any special tools or sealants.
Low maintenance

The only maintenance required is an occasional wipe or wash down.

Vandal resistant

Highly resistant to attack from vandals - can be fixed flush to a wall to prevent anyone climbing up the downpipe.

Cost-effective solution

Competitively priced against leading plastic systems and inexpensive compared with aluminium and cast iron.

Quick and easy to install

product.name: Marsh Portapurra Temporary Pumped Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The portable and compact Portapura sewage treatment tank from Marsh Industries has been specifically designed for temporary accommodation (caravans/travel homes), site offices, site toilets and workshops. The Portapura can be installed above or below ground and treats domestic wastewater to a level that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard.
What are the benefits of choosing Marsh Portapura?
This compact and portable sewage treatment tank is designed specifically for temporary buildings. Design objectives included performance, running costs, installation, transport and storage, making the Portapura the logical choice for sites where temporary buildings are required.
The Portapura’s compact design provides quick and easy installation (where below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours) with minimum visual impact on the surrounding landscape as well as simple and safe access for maintenance and cleaning.  Systems can be installed above ground and removed/stored when not in use.
The cost of installing and running the Portapura is minimal when compared to larger, commercial systems making it one of the more cost-effective sewage treatment tanks on the market.
Another benefit of choosing the Portapura sewage treatment tank is its impact on the environment. Being CE?approved to BS EN 12566 with an ammonia result that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard means the Portapura is well within discharge consent requirements.
Technical

Available in three sizes - 2, 3 or 5 person units (gravity or pumped outlet)
Compact, lightweight construction - No heavy plant required
Portable
Cost effective installation - Below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours
Outstanding treatment efficiency - 14:19:0.7mg/ltr (BOD:Suspended solids:Ammonia)
Near silent air compressor - Ensures minimal running, maintenance and servicing costs
Electrical consumption: 1.8kWh/d - Equivalent to the daily use of a lightbulb
CE?approved to BS?EN 12566
Fire resistance tested in accordance with EN ISO 11925-2:210
Tested for structural integrity in accordance with EN ISO 179-1/1eA
Neck extensions are available for deeper installations

Do not install a Portapura treatment plant in water logged or uneven ground.
Do not remove the covers of the Portapura, or access the unit in any way, without firstly isolating the mains power.
product.variant_name: Marsh Portapura 2 Person Temporary Sewage Treatment Plant - Pumped

Heavy duty shell as standard to enable installation in all ground conditions
Integral lifting eyes for improved on-site handling
Unique ‘keying-in’ lip to assist anchoring into granular or concrete surround

Modern environmental regulations either discourage or ban the use of cesspools (Cesspools are not permitted in Scotland), and instead connections to municipal sewage systems or package sewage treatment plants are encouraged or required.In many countries, planning and development regulations for the protection of the environment prevent home-owners who live close to rivers and environmentally sensitive areas from installing a cesspit or septic system, requiring a sewage treatment plant instead.

product.name: Marsh Ensign Ultra Advanced Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description: The Ensign domestic sewage treatment plant comes with lifting eyes to make unloading and installation faster and safer. We designed the Ensign plant to self-level on the base and with our unique pipe connections ensure the installation is undertaken efficiently and correctly. The six person Ensign Sewage plant is extremely strong and is only 1.95m in depth with an inlet invert of 500mm, this design reduces both the time and cost of installation, in normal ground conditions the unit only requires a pea-shingle surround. For guidance ideally the Ensign plant should be 7m from a dwelling or10m from a stream.Package Sewage Treatment Plants (or PSTP's) are often a suitable option where groundwater in the surrounding environment is vulnerable, drainage field percolation values are restrictive, or direct discharge to watercourse or surface water sewer is the preferred discharge method. Marsh Industries Ensign range of sewage treatment plants treat final effluent to British and European Standards to allow it to be discharged back into the watercourse whilst reaching national consent standards. Our tanks can be manufactured with either a gravity or pumped outlet to meet your site requirements. At Marsh Industries we only use 100% virgin resin (no chalk fillers) in all our products. Lead times for Domestic Sewage Treatment Plants are normally only 5-7 working days. Comes with external compressor as standard.Features & Benefits: Marsh Ensign Ultra Advanced Domestic Sewage Treatment PlantNo moving partsLow running and maintenance costsEasy installation with keying-in lip and lifting eyesTested and certified to BSEN12566-350 year design life25 year structural guaranteeThe Ensign plant has been tested to EN12566:3-2005Highest testing standard for European testingThe Ensign can discharge direct to a ditch, watercourse or percolation bedSuitable for One 4 bed residence & Two 3 Bed Residences - 16 People or 25 people working.In addition to anaerobic digestion taking place in the primary settlement chamber the Ensign: Ultra unit allows the clarified water to pass into a second 'aeration' chamber where it is treated to remove the dissolved constituents. Here aerobic bacteria supported by diffused air and mobile media, ensures full treatment is achieved before the treated effluent and 'sloughed off' bacteria flows to a final settlement chamber. The final effluent is then discharged to the drainage field or watercourse via polylok filter.Please note: External Cabinet can be supplied free of charge, please state when ordering.

product.name: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe
product.description: This Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe is part of a sturdy and flexible dry-jointed pipework system that is easy to install and suited to various applications. It is lightweight yet durable, making it resistant to accidental external damage and vandalism, and eco-friendly with a recyclable cast iron structure.With a choice of ductile or stainless steel couplings, the complete soil and waste pipework system covers installation from pipework connection to stack to underground sewer connection. It is compatible with rainwater installations alongside Harmer Roof Outlets with pipes in lengths of 3m and diameters ranging from 50mm to 400mm. You can construct your system using the twin screw couplings. Socketless fixing between pipe and fittings is easy but secure without special installation equipment.Features & Benefits: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain PipeLightweight but strong cast ironHigh tensile strengthEasily assembled with socketless fixingResilient primer and epoxy coatings for low maintenanceRecyclable after useSystem suited to various applicationsThe pipes and fittings from this system are crafted from grey iron to DIN 1691 (exceeds BS 1452 Grade 150 ISO 185 Grade 15), while the couplings feature stainless steel and ductile cast iron constructions. The pipes are coated with a primer (minimum thickness of 40 µm) on their exteriors and an epoxy coating (minimum thickness of 120 µm) on their interiors. Fittings, however, are coated both externally and internally with an epoxy coating (minimum thickness 60 µm). These epoxy coatings mean that pipes and fittings will only require minimal maintenance during their service life.High in tensile strength and non-combustible to prevent the need for fire protection collars, Harmer SML stands as a cutting-edge cast iron technology, with BBA certification, full compliance with BS EN 877, Kitemark certification, and CE Mark conformity.Standards & CertificationMeets British and European Standards: BS EN 877 and BS EN 14366; 2004 for excellent noise attenuationCertification: BBA Agrément certifiedCE Mark: European product conformity to harmonised standard BS EN 877 in accordance with Construction Products Regulation 2013Kitemark Certification: in accordance with BS EN877

product.name: HARMER SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe Puddle Flange
product.description:
Harmer SML is a lightweight, dry jointed pipework system at the leading edge of cast iron technology. BBA Agrément Certified and fully compliant with BS EN 877, Kitemark certification and with CE Mark conformity, this proven system has more than 30 years' use throughout Europe.
Applications

A complete soil and waste pipework system
Covers installation from pipework connection to stack to underground sewer connection
Also suited to rainwater installations in conjunction with Harmer Roof Outlets
Pipes available in standard 3m lengths, in diameters of 50mm to 400mm
Choice of ductile or stainless steel couplings

Installation & Fixing

Assembled by means of twin screw couplings
Secure socketless fixing between pipe and fitting
No special installation equipment required
Epoxy coatings ensure pipes and fittings need minimal maintenance over lifetime of installation

Performance

Agrément certified and meets European Standard BS EN 877
CE Mark: European product conformity to harmonised standard BS EN 877 in accordance with Construction Products Regulation 2013
Kitemark Certification in accordance with BS EN877
Lightweight, strong and durable
Excellent noise attenuation, tested to BS EN 14366: 2004
Non-combustible - fire protection collars not necessary
High tensile strength
Inherent resistance to external accidental damage and vandalism
Quick to assemble
100% recyclable

Materials & Finishes

Pipes and fittings manufactured in grey iron to DIN 1691  (exceeds BS 1452 Grade 150 ISO 185 Grade 15)
Couplings are manufactured in stainless steel and ductile cast iron
Pipes exterior have a primer coat, minimum thickness 40 µm
Pipes interior have an epoxy coating with a minimum thickness of 120 µm
Fittings are coated externally and internally with an epoxy coating, minimum thickness 60 µm

product.name: Freeflow Half Round Plastic Gutter
product.description:
Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Freeflow Plastic Ogee Gutter Internal Stopend
product.description:
The Freeflow ogee gutter system includes a traditional ‘s’ curved style gutter with a complete range of matching fittings to ensure a water-tight professional installation. An additional benefit for customers is the symmetrical shape of the ogee gutter which eliminates the need to stock a range of left and right hand parts. The gutter is 135mm wide, 77mm deep and is 4m long. All ogee gutter system parts are available in white, black, brown and caramel. Square or round pipe systems may be fitted to the ogee gutter system.Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Graf One2Clean Plus Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The One2Clean Plus sewage treatment plant from Graf will treat the water, so that it is clean enough to be discharged into a water course (depending on how frequently it is being used and the manufacturer’s guidelines). However, One2Clean Plus sewage treatment plants do require a power source and requires emptying approximately every year.
The water discharged from the One2Clean Plus packaged treatment plant must meet the relevant British Standard which is BS EN 12566 for small sewage treatment plants and BS 6297:2007 for drainage fields.
Graf One2Clean Plus Sewage Treatment Plant Process

Untreated waste enters the One2Clean tank via the inlet on the side.
Wastewater then falls directly into the biological zone where the treatment takes place, allowing micro-organisms to start the breakdown process.
Compressed air is used initially for aeration through the diffuser, intermittent to achieve the best treatment performance.
Aeration is then stopped allowing the activated waste to sink to the bottom.
Compressed air is sent through the One2Clean tank once again, extracting the cleaned water near the surface.
This water passes through a sampling point before leaving the plant, where samples can be taken to confirm the quality of effluent.
The above process occurs twice per day, each lasting 12 hours.
The sludge which builds up at the bottom of the tank must also be emptied in line with the manufacturer’s instructions
Numerous companiescan dispose of the waste, these must be a registered waste carrier

Features & Benefits

One tank with just one chamber
Less energy consumption
No mechanical elements in the wastewater
No pumps in the wastewater
No electrical components in the wastewater
Incredibly low volume of sewage sludge
Odourless, clear treated water for extraction
State-of-the-art manufacturing for maximum stability
100% watertight and corrosion-resistant
Can be installed in groundwater
Simple maintenance via an integrated, self-cleaning sampling container
More advanced control panel than the standard One2Clean
Control panel allows additional plug in retro fitting of add on systems

product.name: Graf Carat Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvester Package
product.description: Designed for outdoor cleaning and irrigation purposes, the Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvesting system by Graf is ideal for collecting rainwater from the roof of your property and then feeding it into the underground tank via the downpipes. Available in various sizes, you can use the harvester for domestic or commercial use with the choice of either an A15 lid for pedestrian use or a B125 cast iron lid for light vehicular use.Before entering the underground tank, the water passes through a filter to remove debris, ensuring clear water for use. An underground pressure-sensitive pump is also installed. When a valve or tap is opened, the water is pumped under pressure until the valve is closed allowing the system to re-pressurise and turn off the power to the pump.Features & Benefits: Graf Carat Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvester PackageLightweight for easy handling and transportationEasy and safe to assembleA15 and B125 lid options and choice of harvester sizes availableEPDM used to profile sealings and ensure minimum life of 25 yearsConstant monitoring of production ensures consistent qualitySuitable for vehicle loading when a telescopic cast iron cover is usedTwo additional hose-lock connection extraction pointsFilter prevents leaves, moss and debris from travelling with the rainwater out of the tankFilter package 2 consists of an internal Universal Filter 3, an inflow stilling system for controlling the water inflow as well as a Spannfix connection sleeve, Rodent Guard and an Overflow siphon. The Integra Inox Submersible pump features an automatic start/stop function with a floating water extraction unit and protection against dry running.Please note: If you have an above-ground tank, you can use a pump to extract the rainwater. However, if the tank is underground, you'll need a pump to extract the rainwater. It's important to consider what you'll be using the harvested rainwater for, as this will determine whether you need a backup function for periods where little rainwater is collected.

product.name: Graf Klaro E Professional Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plants by Graf are always a good choice. They are flexibly adapted to meet the stricter discharge values in water protection areas. No live parts need to be installed in the Klaro E Professional. Movement processes are created by three air lift pumps that are operated using a compressor which is built into the control.
The Graf Klaro E Professional wastewater treatment system does not need consistent integration of live technology in the tank. Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plant can be flexibly adjusted to changing conditions by altering the cycle times. The air pressure holes are colour coded to avoid installation errors; the whole system just needs to be fitted to the baffle of the reservoir.
Graf Klaro E Professional Sewage Treatment Plant Features & Benefits

No live technology in the reservoir
Air compressor is very durable and whisper-quiet
Flexible, as expandable
Can be switched to holiday mode
Easy to install
Low maintenance
10-year warranty on sewage reservoirs
2-year warranty on technology

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron H460 Hopper Head
product.description: This standard rainwater head acts as a funnel, collecting and channelling rainwater into the downpipes and drains below. Made from robust, reliable and strong cast iron, this hopper has been tried and tested, withstanding many difficulties such as on-site handling, vandalism and mechanical de-blocking. Flame resistant and non-combustible, this hopper head does not require fire collars or extra lagging etc.Surviving the long life of a building, this hopper head is fully sustainable, made from infinitely recyclable cast iron and unlike plastic will not end up in a landfill. This hopper head is ideal for restoration, conservation, refurbishment and heritage work as well as unique, bespoke and new designs on public, domestic, commercial or industrial buildings. Recommended annual inspections once installed this hopper head has low maintenance needs with remedial action is not usually required. With good noise dampening properties, this hopper head does not rattle in high winds with very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures meaning no clicking or creaking.Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron H460 Hopper HeadAvailable in a range of sizes and downpipe diameters with your choice of primed or painted black  Painted black by paint specialists in factory conditions  Primed using dark grey RAL 7024 and can be top coated with Acrylic, Epoxy or Polyurethane paint  Internally and externally painted  Withstanding of heavy weights such as heavy snow or ladders  Minimal maintenance requirements with a long-lasting installation  Excellent noise dampening properties and flame resistant  Made from infinitely recyclable, sustainable cast iron  Cost-effective in the long term  Made to British Standards of BS EN 877, certified by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754, BBA approved 06/4401 and UKCA and CE approvedAvailable in a range of sizes and downpipe diameters to match your downpipes, this hopper head can be painted black or primed. Painted internally and externally, the primed hopper head is coated in a dark grey primer providing a surface for subsequent coats of paint to effortlessly adhere to. The primed layer provides short-term protection to the surface and creates a barrier to corrosion until it can be overcoated with Polyurethane, Acrylic or Epoxy paint. The painted black hopper head provides an excellent paint finish that is vital to longevity and performance and protects the underlying substrate by providing a barrier between the Cast Iron and corroding elements.

Made from robust, reliable and strong cast iron, this hopper has been tried and tested, withstanding many difficulties such as on-site handling, vandalism and mechanical de-blocking. Flame resistant and non-combustible, this hopper head does not require fire collars or extra lagging etc.Surviving the long life of a building, this hopper head is fully sustainable, made from infinitely recyclable cast iron and unlike plastic will not end up in a landfill. This hopper head is ideal for restoration, conservation, refurbishment and heritage work as well as unique, bespoke and new designs on public, domestic, commercial or industrial buildings. Recommended annual inspections once installed this hopper head has low maintenance needs with remedial action is not usually required. With good noise dampening properties, this hopper head does not rattle in high winds with very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures meaning no clicking or creaking.Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron H460 Hopper HeadAvailable in a range of sizes and downpipe diameters with your choice of primed or painted black  Painted black by paint specialists in factory conditions  Primed using dark grey RAL 7024 and can be top coated with Acrylic, Epoxy or Polyurethane paint  Internally and externally painted  Withstanding of heavy weights such as heavy snow or ladders  Minimal maintenance requirements with a long-lasting installation  Excellent noise dampening properties and flame resistant  Made from infinitely recyclable, sustainable cast iron  Cost-effective in the long term  Made to British Standards of BS EN 877, certified by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754, BBA approved 06/4401 and UKCA and CE approvedAvailable in a range of sizes and downpipe diameters to match your downpipes, this hopper head can be painted black or primed. Painted internally and externally, the primed hopper head is coated in a dark grey primer providing a surface for subsequent coats of paint to effortlessly adhere to. The primed layer provides short-term protection to the surface and creates a barrier to corrosion until it can be overcoated with Polyurethane, Acrylic or Epoxy paint. The painted black hopper head provides an excellent paint finish that is vital to longevity and performance and protects the underlying substrate by providing a barrier between the Cast Iron and corroding elements.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Side Offset
product.description:
This rectangular downpipe side offset is available in a range of diameters and is compatible with the Hargreaves rectangular pipes and fittings. Made from tried and tested cast iron, this offset is strong, reliable and durable, withstanding the difficulties of on-site handling, vandalism and mechanical de-blocking.With good sound dampening properties, this side offset is also non-combustible requiring no extra lagging, fire collars etc. Manufactured from 100% recyclable cast iron, this side offset is fully sustainable and can withstand the long life of a building and unlike plastic, will not end up in a landfill. Suitable for conservation, heritage, refurbishment and restoration work as well as bespoke, new and unique designs on commercial, industrial, public or domestic buildings, this side offset has low maintenance requirements once installed with annual inspections recommended but remedial action is not usually needed.
Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Side OffsetAvailable in a range of sizes with your choice of primed or painted black  Primed offset painted using RAL 7024 dark grey and can be top-coated with Epoxy, Acrylic or Polyurethane paint  Internally and externally painted  Low sound levels due to very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures, therefore, no clicking or creaking and not rattling in high winds  Durable, reliable and strong cast iron material  Made from sustainable, 100% recyclable cast iron  Made to British Standards of BS EN 877, BBA approved 06/4401 and certified by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754  UKCA and CE approved  Cost-effective with long-lasting, minimal maintenance, fire resistance and good sound dampening properties
With your choice of painted black or primed side offset, this offset is internally and externally painted. The painted offset provides an excellent paint finish which is vital to the longevity and performance of your Cast Iron offset, protecting the underlying substrate by providing a barrier between the Cast Iron and corroding elements and carried out by paint specialists in factory conditions. The primed side offset is coated in a dark grey primer which provides a surface that subsequent coats of paint can effortlessly adhere to, providing temporary protection to the surface and creating a barrier to corrosion until it can be overcoated with Acrylic, Polyurethane or Epoxy paint.

This rectangular downpipe side offset is available in a range of diameters and is compatible with the Hargreaves rectangular pipes and fittings. Made from tried and tested cast iron, this offset is strong, reliable and durable, withstanding the difficulties of on-site handling, vandalism and mechanical de-blocking.With good sound dampening properties, this side offset is also non-combustible requiring no extra lagging, fire collars etc. Manufactured from 100% recyclable cast iron, this side offset is fully sustainable and can withstand the long life of a building and unlike plastic, will not end up in a landfill. Suitable for conservation, heritage, refurbishment and restoration work as well as bespoke, new and unique designs on commercial, industrial, public or domestic buildings, this side offset has low maintenance requirements once installed with annual inspections recommended but remedial action is not usually needed.
Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Side OffsetAvailable in a range of sizes with your choice of primed or painted black  Primed offset painted using RAL 7024 dark grey and can be top-coated with Epoxy, Acrylic or Polyurethane paint  Internally and externally painted  Low sound levels due to very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures, therefore, no clicking or creaking and not rattling in high winds  Durable, reliable and strong cast iron material  Made from sustainable, 100% recyclable cast iron  Made to British Standards of BS EN 877, BBA approved 06/4401 and certified by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754  UKCA and CE approved  Cost-effective with long-lasting, minimal maintenance, fire resistance and good sound dampening properties
With your choice of painted black or primed side offset, this offset is internally and externally painted. The painted offset provides an excellent paint finish which is vital to the longevity and performance of your Cast Iron offset, protecting the underlying substrate by providing a barrier between the Cast Iron and corroding elements and carried out by paint specialists in factory conditions. The primed side offset is coated in a dark grey primer which provides a surface that subsequent coats of paint can effortlessly adhere to, providing temporary protection to the surface and creating a barrier to corrosion until it can be overcoated with Acrylic, Polyurethane or Epoxy paint.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Plain Earband
product.description: This cast iron rectangular downpipe plain earband is designed to hold a rectangular downpipe in place against a wall. Due to the number of downpipe sizes available, Hargreaves has made sure their range of earbands comes in a variety of sizes to suit your specific downpipe dimensions. You can also opt for black or primed colour depending on your aesthetic requirements. The cast iron rectangular earband is manufactured to the BS460 standard. By choosing cast iron, you're deciding to use a sustainable and durable material that can withstand a variety of factors. Sustainability means it can be fully recycled after its lifetime use and not 'downcycled' like other materials. For resistance, it is highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Type C Ornamental Earband
product.description:
Rectangular rainwater pipes come in a choice of 100mm x 75mm, 125mm x 70mm, 125mm x 100mm and 150mm x 100mm diameters and in standard lengths of 0.6m, 0.9m, 1.2m and 1.8m. Produced by the vertical cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. The premier standard rainwater range includes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.
Cast Iron is a sustainable material, this means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'. Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. Cast iron gutters are able to withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy snow. Correctly installed and maintained Premier Systems can last in excess of 100 years with minimal maintenance requirements - occasional painting approximately every 10 years.
Cast iron is very quiet in operation, with low noise levels due to the sound deading properties of cast iron and they wont rattle in high winds. They have very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of guttering. All Premier rainwater products are manufactured in accordance with BS460.
Bespoke

Any system can be pre-painted in any RAL colour.
Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building.
Ears can be added to any standard fitting.
Hopper heads can be customised with dates or embellishments.

Rectangular rainwater pipes come in a choice of 100mm x 75mm, 125mm x 70mm, 125mm x 100mm and 150mm x 100mm diameters and in standard lengths of 0.6m, 0.9m, 1.2m and 1.8m. Produced by the vertical cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. The premier standard rainwater range includes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.
Cast Iron is a sustainable material, this means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'. Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. Cast iron gutters are able to withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy snow. Correctly installed and maintained Premier Systems can last in excess of 100 years with minimal maintenance requirements - occasional painting approximately every 10 years.
Cast iron is very quiet in operation, with low noise levels due to the sound deading properties of cast iron and they wont rattle in high winds. They have very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of guttering. All Premier rainwater products are manufactured in accordance with BS460.
Bespoke

Any system can be pre-painted in any RAL colour.
Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building.
Ears can be added to any standard fitting.
Hopper heads can be customised with dates or embellishments.

Prices on application please call for details.

product.description: Hargreaves Foundry crafts a wide array of strong and sturdy cast iron rainwater guttering systems, including the G46 moulded gutters and fittings range - which involves this moulded gutter, designed for catching rainwater from the roofline. Similarly to its Hargreaves Foundry's cast iron counterparts, this moulded gutter is suitable for an assortment of applications, such as domestic, commercial, public, and industrial applications due to its reliable and long-lasting structure that is designed to live for as long as your build. product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Notts OG Gutter External Stopend
product.description: Compatible with the Cast Iron Notts OG rainwater gutters, this external stopend can be used at the end of the gutter run to close off the guttering. Manufactured from reliable, durable and strong cast iron, this stopend has been tried and tested, withstanding multiple difficulties such as vandalism, on-site handling and mechanical de-blocking.This fully sustainable stopend is made from infinitely recyclable cast iron, can survive the long life of a building and will not end up in a landfill like plastic. Suitable for bespoke, unique and new designs as well as conservation, restoration, heritage and refurbishment work on domestic, public, industrial or commercial buildings, this stopend has minimal maintenance requirements. With suggested annual inspections once installed, remedial action is not normally needed. This non-combustible and flame resistant stopend does not require fire collars or extra lagging etc and has good sound dampening properties with minimal expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures and no rattling in high winds.Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron Notts OG Gutter External StopendAvailable with your choice of primed or painted black  Painted black in factory conditions by paint specialists  Primed using RAL 7024 dark grey and can be coated with Epoxy, Acrylic or Polyurethane paints  Externally and internally painted  Withstands the weight of ladders or heavy snow  Long-lasting installation with low maintenance requirements  Good noise dampening properties and fire-resistant  Made from sustainable, 100% recyclable cast iron  Cost-effective in the long term  Manufactured to British Standards of BS EN 877, BBA approved 06/4401 and certified by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754  UKCA and CE approvedAvailable in painted black or primed, this stopend is painted internally and externally. The painted black stopend provides a good paint finish which is vital to the performance and longevity of your gutters, protecting the underlying substrate by creating a barrier between the corroding elements and Cast Iron. The primed stopend is coated in a dark grey primer which provides a surface for subsequent coats of paint to easily adhere to. Providing temporary protection to the surface, the primed layer creates a barrier to corrosion until it can be overcoated with Acrylic, Epoxy or Polyurethane paint.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron OG Gutter Union
product.description: Used to join two sections of Cast Iron OG gutters in a range of sizes, this gutter union can be fixed to your fascia board to support the joint. Made from strong, robust and reliable cast iron, this gutter union has been tried and tested, enduring many difficulties such as on-site handling, vandalism and mechanical de-blocking.Made from infinitely recyclable cast iron, this gutter union is fully sustainable, can survive the long life of a building and unlike plastic, will not end up in a landfill. Ideal for unique, new and bespoke designs as well as refurbishment, conservation, restoration and heritage work on commercial, industrial, public or domestic buildings, this gutter union requires minimal maintenance once installed. With recommended annual inspections, remedial action is not normally necessary. This gutter union is flame resistant and non-combustible and does not require extra lagging or fire collars etc. With good sound dampening properties, this gutter union does not rattle in the winds and resists expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures.Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron OG Gutter UnionAvailable with your choice of painted black or primed in a range of sizes  Painted black by paint specialists in factory conditions and primed using dark grey RAL 7024 can be coated with Acrylic, Polyurethane or Epoxy paints  Internally and externally painted  Withstanding weight of heavy snow or ladder  Minimal maintenance requirements and long-lasting installation  Fire-resistant and good sound dampening properties  Made from infinitely recyclable, sustainable cast iron  Cost-effective in the long term  Made to British Standards to BS EN 877, BBA certified 06/4401 and approved by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754  UKCA and CE certifiedAvailable in your choice of primed dark grey or painted black, this gutter union has been externally and internally painted. The painted black gutter union ensures a good paint finish which is vital to the longevity and performance of your gutters and protects the underlying surface by creating a barrier between the Cast Iron and corroding elements. The primed gutter union is coated in a dark grey primer, providing a surface for subsequent layers of paint to readily adhere to. Creating a barrier to corrosion as temporary protection, this gutter union can be overcoated with Epoxy, Acrylic or Polyurethane paint.

Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'.Round rainwater pipes in a choice of 65mm, 75mm, 100mm and 150mm diameters and in standard lengths of 0.6m, 0.9m, 1.2m and 1.8m. Produced by the vertical cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. The premier standard rainwater range includes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. Cast iron gutters are able to withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy snow.Correctly installed and maintained Premier Systems can last in excess of 100 years with minimal maintenance requirements - occasional painting approximately every 10 years.Cast iron is very quiet in operation, with low noise levels due to the sound deading properties of cast iron and they wont rattle in high winds. They have very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of guttering.All Premier rainwater products are manfactuered in accordance with BS460.Bespoke

Any system can be pre painted in any RAL colour.
Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building.
Ears can be added to any standard fitting.
Hopper heads can be customised with dates or embellishments.

Prices on application please call for details.

product.description: This half round external stop end outlet from Hargreaves Foundry is an ideal option to incorporate into your guttering when your downpipe is positioned at the end of your gutter run.Serving two purposes in one fitting, this stopend outlet is cleverly designed to form a solid joint between your outlet and your downpipe while also stopping rainwater from falling out of the gutter run. Hargreaves Foundry’s cast iron collection is perfect for rainwater systems due to their lasting material which has a very prolonged life expectancy, alongside their stealthy aversion to corrosion and damage. product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Half Round Gutter Internal Stopend Outlet
product.description:
Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'.Round rainwater pipes in a choice of 65mm, 75mm, 100mm and 150mm diameters and in standard lengths of 0.6m, 0.9m, 1.2m and 1.8m. Produced by the vertical cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. The premier standard rainwater range includes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. Cast iron gutters are able to withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy snow.Correctly installed and maintained Premier Systems can last in excess of 100 years with minimal maintenance requirements - occasional painting approximately every 10 years.Cast iron is very quiet in operation, with low noise levels due to the sound deading properties of cast iron and they wont rattle in high winds. They have very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of guttering.All Premier rainwater products are manfactuered in accordance with BS460.Bespoke

Any system can be pre painted in and RAL colour.
Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building.
Ears can be added to any standard fitting.
Hopper heads can be customised with dates or embellishments.

Prices on application please call for details.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Half Round Gutter Fascia Bracket
product.description:
Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'.
Round rainwater pipes in a choice of 65mm, 75mm, 100mm and 150mm diameters and in standard lengths of 0.6m, 0.9m, 1.2m and 1.8m. Produced by the vertical cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. The premier standard rainwater range includes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.
Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. Cast iron gutters are able to withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy snow.
Correctly installed and maintained Premier Systems can last in excess of 100 years with minimal maintenance requirements - occasional painting approximately every 10 years.
Cast iron is very quiet in operation, with low noise levels due to the sound deading properties of cast iron and they wont rattle in high winds. They have very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of guttering.
All Premier rainwater products are manfactuered in accordance with BS460.Bespoke

Any system can be pre painted in and RAL colour.
Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building.
Ears can be added to any standard fitting.
Hopper heads can be customised with dates or embellishments.

Prices on application please call for details.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron OG Gutter Fascia Bracket
product.description:
Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'.
Round rainwater pipes in a choice of 65mm, 75mm, 100mm and 150mm diameters and in standard lengths of 0.6m, 0.9m, 1.2m and 1.8m. Produced by the vertical cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. The premier standard rainwater range includes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.
Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. Cast iron gutters are able to withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy snow.
Correctly installed and maintained Premier Systems can last in excess of 100 years with minimal maintenance requirements - occasional painting approximately every 10 years.
Cast iron is very quiet in operation, with low noise levels due to the sound deading properties of cast iron and they wont rattle in high winds. They have very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of guttering.
All Premier rainwater products are manfactuered in accordance with BS460.Bespoke

Any system can be pre painted in and RAL colour.
Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building.
Ears can be added to any standard fitting.
Hopper heads can be customised with dates or embellishments.

product.name: Hargreaves Foundry Cast Iron 100mm Soil Pipe Short Radius Bend
product.description:
Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'.
Cast Iron Soil pipes in a choice of 50mm, 70mm, 100mm, 150mm, 200mm, 250mm and 300mm diameters and in a standard length of 3m. The Halifax system complies with Bristish and European standard BS EN 877 and provides a complete system of pipes and fittings for the conveyance of waste water and rainwater through a building and as far as the sewer.
The combination of great strength and improved surface coatings on the Halifax Soil and Drain System delivers a fit and forget solution in most installations. This is especially important when pipework is concealed and inaccessible and where maintenance would be disruptive to occupants of the building.
The Max and Connect couplings share a similar single screw design for above ground applications. Both couplings provide the quickest jointing method available on the market today for BS EN 877 above ground systems. Also for installations requiring cast iron couplings to match pipework the Haliface ductile cast iron coupling is available.
Please note, all red Hargreaves Foundry Cast Iron Soil Pipes are non-returnable and cannot be refunded.

product.name: Hargreaves Foundry Cast Iron 150mm Soil Pipe Short Radius Bend
product.description:
Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'.
Cast Iron Soil pipes in a choice of 50mm, 70mm, 100mm, 150mm, 200mm, 250mm and 300mm diameters and in a standard length of 3m. The Halifax system complies with Bristish and European standard BS EN 877 and provides a complete system of pipes and fittings for the conveyance of waste water and rainwater through a building and as far as the sewer.
The combination of great strength and improved surface coatings on the Halifax Soil and Drain System delivers a fit and forget solution in most installations. This is especially important when pipework is concealed and inaccessible and where maintenance would be disruptive to occupants of the building.
The Max and Connect couplings share a similar single screw design for above ground applications. Both couplings provide the quickest jointing method available on the market today for BS EN 877 above ground systems. Also for installations requiring cast iron couplings to match pipework the Haliface ductile cast iron coupling is available.
Please note, all red Hargreaves Foundry Cast Iron Soil Pipes are non-returnable and cannot be refunded.
